cohortSemantics.primaryRecommendation: 32-row plurality core is the proposed primary grade cohort; owner evaluation lock remains separate.
cohortSemantics.full35: Keep all35 named principal pairs visible. The 32/core and 3/conditional cohorts are fixed before results.
cohortSemantics.conditional3: Alaska and Maine require an official observed exact two-candidate final round. Georgia requires a certified decisive no-runoff general or qualifying exact-principal runoff.
cohortSemantics.gradeTarget: Named-pair margin and first-versus-second relative lead, not unconditional all-candidate or legal office winner.
cohortSemantics.sameResultRevision: F and FP must use the same admitted official result record revision and frozen cohort.

policy: No newFlorida2026writ/term-end notice captured; existing accepted class3special native identity is preserved, with new vacancy law/candidate metadata support only.
AK direct current statute/page access blocked; current officialFAQ is public search-rendered. Petition/proposedbill text is not current statutory proof.
AK/ME candidate ballot refreshes blocked; exact native pairs remain the already admitted official-source identities, not freshly requalified current menus.
No future official result candidate/contest IDs, certified round files or actual result source versions exist in this packet.
resultRouteRegistry: Alabama, Colorado, and Georgia: no official results/certification landing route verified in this bounded source pass; exact roster source URLs remain preserved per candidate.
Louisiana: state elections authority page found; a distinct statewide result/certification landing route not verified.
Nebraska and New Hampshire: official election-cycle page identifies results navigation, but the distinct result route was not confirmed.
Montana, Ohio, Oregon, South Dakota, Texas: official reporting pages surfaced; only route metadata recorded; any testing/mock/live totals were excluded.
West Virginia: statewide results service surfaced with event key eid=14; its mapping to the future November 2026 general contest is unverified and must not be assumed.
Wyoming: results landing page shows 2026 cycle navigation, but November 2026 general-results route is not yet separately verified.

sourceFinalityPolicy.future_actual_source_admission: Before operator use, independently admit exact official source bytes/version, observed source/contest/round identifiers and each candidate-ID crosswalk. Pin raw bytes withSHA256,URL/retrievalUTC and format. Metadata registry routes alone do not supply admission.
sourceFinalityPolicy.certified_final_only: Final scoring requires official certified/contest-final status with explicit no pending recount or result-affecting dispute; scheduled deadlines,100%reporting, calls or provider labels do not substitute.
sourceFinalityPolicy.preliminary: An admitted official preliminary source with reviewed identity/event/round may supply descriptive pair values only. Final-score eligibility false. Missing/unknown finality remains pending. Never display a final grade from preliminary data.
sourceFinalityPolicy.revisions: Each official correction/recount/certification revision becomes a new immutable result version with raw/source/crosswalk/round/event pins, observedUTC, supersedes pointer and reason. Keep earlier bytes/results, mark superseded; recompute both unchanged F/FP against the same new result version and frozen cohort. Do not revise forecasts or mutate old scores in place.
escalation: candidate replacement/death/disqualification or unresolved source identity
court order, pending recount or result-affecting contest
sourceFinalityPolicy.unknowns: Unresolved cases retain unavailable/pending status with reason; no inferred legal tie rule, invented source ID, cloned candidate, missing count fill or optional pair reconstruction.
